name: Seniors' Sense of Safety in Living Streets (Tianjin)
description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views around Dingzigu Street, Tianjin, not the paper's stimuli. Older adults (60+) rate each street view on five kinds of sense of security from the paper's semantic-differential analysis (spatial security, walking, visual perception, rest and relaxation, social interaction) from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), and give the paper's background information (age, gender, years in the community, education, monthly income). From Sun, Nie, Wang, Huang & Tian (2024, Buildings). Differences from the original study: (1) the paper lists the five kinds of security with explanations but not the exact statements, so the statements here are written from those explanations; (2) the paper's 1024×450 images had a 180° field of view, these have 120°; (3) 15 images per participant.
author: Sun, Nie, Wang, Huang & Tian

dimensions.label: Sense of spatial security: I feel comfortable, safe and relaxed in this street space.
Sense of security while walking: I would feel safe walking here.
Sense of security in visual perception: I can see the surroundings, signs and the view clearly here.
Sense of security during rest: I would feel safe resting here.
Sense of security in social interaction: I would feel safe meeting and chatting with people here.
